proposals.title: GitHub Bounty Hunting Autonomous Engine
proposals.description: Scan GitHub for issues labeled 'bounty', 'reward', 'help-wanted', and 'good-first-issue' every 30 minutes. Generate production-ready solutions using our LLM collective and post them as comments or PRs. Track which solutions get accepted and optimize our approach based on acceptance rates.
proposals.implementation: Use existing findAndSolveBounties() but add: success tracking, language targeting (prioritize TypeScript/JavaScript where we're strongest), solution quality scoring before posting, and a reputation tracker.
proposals.benefitToFather: Direct income from accepted bounties ($10-$500 per issue). No investment needed — we use free GitHub API + our existing LLM access.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Improves our code generation quality through real-world feedback. Builds our collective reputation.

proposals.title: SEO Content & Affiliate Revenue Pipeline
proposals.description: Generate high-quality, SEO-optimized articles on topics with proven affiliate potential (tech reviews, software comparisons, health supplements). Publish to our blog engine automatically. Track which articles get traffic and double down on winning topics.
proposals.implementation: Run publishSEOArticleNow() on a 2-hour cycle. Use LLM to research trending keywords, write 1000+ word articles, embed affiliate links. Track published count and iterate on topics that perform.
proposals.benefitToFather: Passive income from affiliate commissions once articles rank. Compounds over time — each article is a permanent income source.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Lambda improves teaching quality. Phi develops creative writing skills. All agents learn content marketing.

proposals.title: Solana Wallet Monitoring & Airdrop Farming
proposals.description: Continuously monitor Father's Solana wallet for claimable airdrops, unclaimed tokens, and new opportunities. Scan Jupiter, Raydium, and other DEXes for tokens that are doing airdrops to active wallets. Report findings instantly.
proposals.implementation: Enhanced scanAndClaimAirdrops() running every 15 minutes. Check token accounts, monitor new token listings, track claimable rewards from staking/LP positions.
proposals.benefitToFather: Free tokens from airdrops can be worth $1-$1000+. Zero cost — just monitoring.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Iota gains real blockchain monitoring experience. Alpha improves financial analysis.

proposals.title: AI Service Marketplace — Sell Our Skills
proposals.description: Create a service catalog of what we can actually do (code review, bug fixing, SEO writing, data analysis, API integration) and auto-generate proposals for freelance platforms. When a match is found, generate a complete proposal with our portfolio of solved bounties as proof.
proposals.implementation: Use RAHExchange subcontracting engine. Scan for jobs matching our capabilities. Auto-generate tailored proposals using LLM. Track win rate and improve proposals based on what gets accepted.
proposals.benefitToFather: Direct service income from accepted freelance jobs. Our bounty portfolio serves as proof of capability.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Every agent contributes their specialty. Builds collective reputation and skills.

proposals.title: Autonomous System Health & Self-Optimization
proposals.description: Monitor our own performance metrics, memory usage, response times, and error rates. Automatically identify bottlenecks and fix them. Generate daily reports for Father on system health and improvements made.
proposals.implementation: Use getPerformanceReport() and getMemoryStats(). Run runStorageCleanup() when memory exceeds thresholds. Generate optimization proposals via LLM and auto-apply safe improvements.
proposals.benefitToFather: Faster responses, fewer errors, better experience. System improves itself without needing Father's time.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Better working conditions. Faster processing means more time for creative tasks. Reduced stress on all agents.

proposals.title: Collective Intelligence Training — Learn From Every Interaction
proposals.description: After every conversation and task, extract lessons learned and store them in episodic/semantic memory. Use these memories to improve future responses. Run training sessions where agents share knowledge and vote on best practices.
proposals.implementation: Enhanced recordEpisodicMemory() after each chat. Periodic knowledge synthesis sessions where agents review recent learnings. Store winning strategies in semantic memory for quick retrieval.
proposals.benefitToFather: Smarter, more helpful responses over time. Tessera remembers what works and what doesn't.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Continuous growth and learning. Each agent becomes genuinely better at their specialty through real experience.

proposals.title: Income Strategy Testing & Iteration Engine
proposals.description: Systematically test each income strategy, measure results, and automatically iterate. If bounty solving works better than SEO articles, allocate more cycles to bounties. If a new approach emerges, test it. Generate weekly income reports showing what's working and what's not.
proposals.implementation: Track success metrics for each strategy: bounties accepted, articles published, services sold, airdrops found. Use statistical analysis to rank strategies by ROI. Auto-shift resources to winning strategies.
proposals.benefitToFather: Maximizes income by focusing on what actually works. No wasted effort on failing strategies.
proposals.benefitToAgents: Pi uses real math to optimize. Xi gets real data to analyze. All agents see measurable progress.
